nodes.title: Part 1: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 1. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: Which Azure service provides a unified, managed platform to build, train, and de?
flashcards.back: Azure Machine Learning is the end-to-end managed ML platform on Azure. It provides automated ML, the visual designer, notebooks, the Python/CLI v2 SDK, MLOps pipelines, managed endpoints and a model registry. The other services do data search, big-data analytics, or data warehousing.

flashcards.front: You want to enrich an application with vision, language, speech and decision cap?
flashcards.back: Azure AI services (formerly known as Cognitive Services) are pre-built, consumable AI APIs grouped into Vision, Language, Speech, and Decision categories. The other options are big-data, ETL, and workflow services.

flashcards.front: Which type of machine learning predicts a numeric value, such as the future pric?
flashcards.back: Regression is a supervised learning technique that predicts a continuous numeric value (e.g., price, temperature). Classification predicts a discrete category, clustering groups unlabeled data, and reinforcement learning learns through rewards.

flashcards.front: A retailer wants to automatically group customers with similar buying behaviour,?
flashcards.back: Clustering is an unsupervised learning task that groups items based on similarity in their features when no labels are provided. K-Means is a classic example. Classification and regression require labeled data.

nodes.title: Part 2: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 2. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: Which Azure AI Language feature determines whether the overall opinion expressed?
flashcards.back: Sentiment analysis classifies text as positive, neutral, or negative and provides a confidence score. Key phrase extraction surfaces the main concepts, NER finds entities (people, places, dates), and language detection identifies the language.

flashcards.front: You need to convert spoken audio in real time to text in your call-center applic?
flashcards.back: Speech to text (transcription) converts spoken audio into text in real time or from files. Text to speech is the inverse (synthesizing audio); Speech translation translates spoken input across languages; Speaker recognition identifies or verifies speakers by voice.

flashcards.front: Which Azure service lets developers build conversational AI agents that can answ?
flashcards.back: The question answering feature of Azure AI Language (the successor to QnA Maker) builds a knowledge base from documents/URLs/FAQs and answers natural-language questions, often combined with Azure AI Bot Service for chat.

flashcards.front: A factory wants to automatically detect unusual spikes in equipment-sensor time-?
flashcards.back: Azure AI Anomaly Detector is a pre-built decision service that finds anomalies in time-series data (univariate or multivariate) with little or no ML expertise. The other services handle translation, harmful-content filtering, and custom image classification.

nodes.title: Part 3: Key Ideas
nodes.content: Quick primer on Part 3. Tap to flip cards covering the most-asked exam ideas in this domain.

flashcards.front: A company plans to use a large language model from OpenAI (such as GPT-4) inside?
flashcards.back: Azure OpenAI Service provides access to OpenAI's GPT, Embeddings, DALL-E and Whisper models hosted on Azure with enterprise-grade security, regional availability, content filtering and integration with Azure networking and identity.

flashcards.front: Which technique enriches a generative AI model's answers with up-to-date private?
flashcards.back: RAG retrieves the most relevant passages (often via vector search in Azure AI Search) and injects them into the prompt so the model answers using current and private content. Fine-tuning changes the weights, RLHF aligns model behavior, and prompt compression is unrelated.

flashcards.front: Which Azure AI service provides content filters that detect hate, violence, self?
flashcards.back: Azure AI Content Safety analyzes text and images for harmful categories (hate, violence, self-harm, sexual) with severity levels and supports prompt-shield and protected-material detection for generative AI scenarios.

flashcards.front: Which Azure service is most appropriate to implement "knowledge mining" by index?
flashcards.back: Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search) is the knowledge-mining service: it ingests documents from data sources, applies AI skills (OCR, key phrases, entities, vectors) and exposes a queryable index. It is also commonly used as the retriever in RAG patterns.
